text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day of the Classic Year.
Bamboo Memory was invited by Yaeno Muteki to go on their first shrine visit of the year, and I accompanied them—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—We're finally in the Classic Class too!
We gotta build up some serious momentum from the start of the year!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Today, let us all pray for the success of our respective journeys.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san, do you have any specific races
you're aiming for during the Classic tier?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right now, after talking with Trainer-san,
I'm on a warrior's pilgrimage until spring! So
I'm not really aiming for any specific race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Flip that around, and depending on our future goals, it wouldn't be weird at all for us to compete against Chiyono O and the others anytime!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. When that time comes, I'd love nothing more
than to compete against you with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right!
Just thinking about it gets me totally pumped~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, we cannot rule out the possibility
that Bamboo Memory may compete against
Yaeno Muteki and the others in the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her chat so warmly with her friends
makes me want to help give her that kind of
opportunity even more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, in order to do that—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“—It seems our turn has come.
Shall we be on our way?”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Let's pray with all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I've heard that Yaeno Muteki, Sakura Chiyono O,
and Mejiro Ardan all primarily
compete in medium distance races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They'll likely head down the Classic Triple Crown path.
However, as of right now, I see Bamboo Memory's
aptitude lying in sprints and miles...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In other words, Bamboo Memory might carve out her own path instead of aiming for the same major races as her friends.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Someday, without fail!!
With the greatest rivals!!!
I'm gonna have the greatest showdown everrrrr!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That day, Bamboo Memory shouted out that "dream."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the road ahead
might end up distancing her
from her "dream"—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, is something wrong?
Are you feeling under the weather or something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...What does Bamboo Memory herself truly think about the path ahead?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she wishes to walk the same path as her friends,
the royal medium-distance road,
then I—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let us keep a broad perspective through early spring.
With that in mind, I prayed alongside Bamboo Memory for success in the Classic tier—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing our Hatsumode visit, we returned to the academy.
Today is supposed to be a rest day from training, but as for Bamboo Memory—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Time to get to work!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There's still plenty for the Disciplinary Committee to do at the start of the year!
That's why I want to dedicate my time today to disciplinary committee duties!
choice_data_list: You're fired up right from the start of the new year, huh...!
You're so motivated right from the start of the new year...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! It's no exaggeration to say that public discipline at the start of the year sets the tone for the entire year!
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Training, races, and disciplinary committee duties, too!
I wanna aim even higher this year, yes I do!!
choice_data_list: ...I wonder if there's anything I can help with, too.
...I wonder if there's anything I can help with, too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Trainer... did you...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted any reference material I could get to judge
Bamboo Memory's future path. So, prepared for the
worst, I tried asking, butâ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Ooooooh!!
I'm so moved, ssir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So you've realized the importance of public morals too, Trainer?!!
I'm super happy to hear that, seriously!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, strike while the iron is hot, uphold public morals!
Trainer, please take this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The documents I received from Bamboo Memory were
completely covered from top to bottom with today's scheduled activities...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Please choose whichever one of these you'd like to help me with, Trainer!
Let's do this together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one I chose was—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now that's the classic choice!
No patrol means no discipline, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Over the New Year holidays, kids in the dorms let their guard down, so rule-breaking isn't uncommon, sir!
Time to mobilize and protect the academy's peace and order!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run 50 laps around the academy for now!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Keep burning hot, even in the new year!!
Bamboo! Memory!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I continued patrolling the campus alongside Bamboo Memory's burning passion,
sensing her unwavering zeal for the disciplinary committee.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mm! To choose an advanced-level activity
right off the bat...!
As expected of you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I know I chose it, but... what is this...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A breach of discipline is a breach of the mind!
Which means!!
A breach of the mind is a breach of discipline!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As one responsible for school discipline,
this is an activity to clear my mind and achieve mental focus!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's close our eyes
and concentrate for an hour!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I caught a glimpse of Bamboo Memory's surprising focus,
sensing her sheer passion for the disciplinary committee.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: School rules and public morals are completely inseparable!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: To realize the importance of reinforcing one's morals by reviewing the school regulations as the new year turns... As expected of you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right!
First, let's review the school rules using my usual method!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pure memorization, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta work hard today so you can recite
all the school rules from memory just like me, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Next! 'The tail hole of the uniform must not be enlarged beyond the regulation size. However, exceptions may be discussed if necessary due to physical circumstances'!!
choice_data_list: Th-The uniform's tail-hole must not exceed regulation size—'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, as I became more familiar with the school regulations,
I got a glimpse of Bamboo Memory's burning passion for the Disciplinary Committee.
